decisions.decision: Do the whole cleanup now. Do not ask Adi to confirm the row list. 1) Re-run probe-live-wiring.mjs (T-102) and probe-checkout-currency.mjs (T-103) against the mirror and record their results on those tasks. 2) Export every matching row to workshop-plan/ops/t107_deleted_rows.json as a backup. Then, in the six funnel tabs, delete only the rows that match the spec patterns: @example.com, utm-probe, the 'placeholder' row, Paid Registrations row 6 and Checkout Starts row 16. Delete bottom-up, then re-read each tab to confirm none are left. 3) Delete the probe attendee through the ops admin route, and remove any example.com probe rows that were synced into the Worker D1 and the Tantra Tracker. 4) Send the two undeployed 'Tantra funnel forms receiver' projects under boards@ to the trash, using the Drive API or a session that is already signed in. If neither works, open a separate small sign-in task instead. 5) Close T-193 as merged into this task, then move this task to review.

T-102 and T-103 held off on probe re-runs only because of these leftover rows. T-193 is folded in here.
